content.text: Bodycam-style first person: the gun leads and the view catches up, camera and gun lean into turns, and walking, jogging and sprinting each have their own chest-cam bob and stride sway.

content.help: <font size="15">Master switch. Turning it off fades all motion out smoothly; turning it on fades back in.</font>
<font size="15">Scales all motion at once: view lag, camera lean, bob, sway and extra gun lean. Your individual sliders still apply on top.</font>

<font size="15">For anyone who gets motion sick. Camera lean, corner peek tilt and resting tilt drop to a quarter, footstep roll and all side-to-side walking sway are removed, and landing shake, recoil camera kick and the Free Aim view overshoot are halved. Default off.</font>
<font size="15">The gun moves freely in a box on screen and the view only turns at the edge, like Bodycam. Bullets follow the barrel and the crosshair follows the gun. Default on.</font>
<font size="15">With Free Aim on, the crosshair moves with your gun to mark where shots go. Turn off if frame generation makes it look broken. Default on.</font>
<font size="15">The barrel: shots go where the gun points, with Free Aim on or off. The crosshair: vanilla, and only used with Free Aim off. Default is the barrel.</font>

<font size="15">The red marker that flashes when you damage something. It sits outside the crosshair, so with the gun off centre it stays at screen centre while your shot lands elsewhere. Default is move it with the gun.</font>
<font size="15">Calibrates how far the crosshair moves when it follows the gun. If the crosshair sits outside the gun's real aim (e.g. Default 1.</font>

<font size="15">Holds the weapon out in front of you like Bodycam while aiming down the sights, so you see more of your arms. The aim is corrected automatically, so the sights still mark the shot. Default off.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">Settings apply live - no restart needed. Default is the tuned feel.</font>
<font size="15">Switch Free Aim on or off on the General page. Free Aim does not affect scopes.</font>

content.help: <font size="15">How far (degrees) the gun can move left or right before the view turns. Measured off Bodycam footage: its gun roams about a third as far as Bodycam-for-Fallout used to allow. Default 3.5.</font>
<font size="15">How far (degrees) the gun can move up or down before the view turns. Measured off Bodycam footage. Default 2.2.</font>

<font size="15">How much of your mouse movement moves the gun inside the box; the rest turns the view. Higher = the gun roams more freely before the view follows, lower = heavier, the view comes along sooner. Default 0.8.</font>

<font size="15">How much the view drifts behind the gun instead of tracking it rigidly, so the screen settles as the gun moves. Catch-up Speed and Smoothness on Look & Lean shape it. Default 0.6.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly the gun drifts back to the centre on its own. 0 = it stays where you left it. Default 1.2.</font>
<font size="15">Free Aim switches off while your weapon is holstered, so exploring has no drifting view or recentering. It eases back in as you draw. Default on.</font>

content.text: Shots Go Where The Sights Point
content.help: <font size="15">Removes the weapon's spread so the bullet lands exactly on the sights. That scatter is applied after your aim, so nothing else can remove it. Default is iron sights only.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">Crosshair, Hit Marker and Shots Follow are on the General page.</font>
<font size="15">Settings apply live - no restart needed.</font>

<font size="15">Switch Weapon Hold on or off on the General page. It works while aiming down iron sights, for every weapon type; scopes are never affected. Gun type is detected from the weapon and its mods.</font>
Making the gun look further away

<font size="15">Raising Sights FOV Change or Hip Weapon FOV Change draws the gun with a wider lens than the world, so it looks further away. Bodycam corrects your aim for that, so the sights keep marking the shot.</font>

View Lag (gun leads, view catches up)

content.help: <font size="15">Off: the view turns exactly with the mouse. For other mods that move the camera.</font>
<font size="15">How far (degrees) the view can trail behind the gun when you turn. 0 disables the lag - including Screen Float, which this also caps. Default 10.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly the view catches up to the gun. Lower = lazier. Default 7.5.</font>
<font size="15">Below 1 overshoots slightly for an organic feel; 1 = no overshoot. With Free Aim on this shapes the Screen Float bounce. Default 0.65.</font>
<font size="15">How much turning it takes to lean the camera and gun. Lower this if you play at high mouse DPI or high in-game sensitivity and the gun moves too much. Default 1.</font>
<font size="15">Slow turning below this is ignored, so small mouse movements don't tilt anything. Raise it if the gun drifts while you make fine aim adjustments. Default 0.1.</font>
<font size="15">Applies the constant resting tilt set below. Off = level resting horizon. Default on.</font>
<font size="15">Lets the camera lean when you strafe (A/D). Off keeps the view from leaning on strafes; the gun still leans. Default on.</font>
<font size="15">How far the view rests tilted, in degrees. Positive hangs right, negative left, 0 = level. Default 1.</font>
<font size="15">Average seconds before the camera settles to the other side. 0 = a fixed tilt that never moves. Default 25.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly it eases across when it does change sides. Low is a slow settle you barely notice; high is a deliberate shift. Default 0.35.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no camera lean from turning.</font>
<font size="15">Camera tilt per unit of turning speed. - leans out of the turn (what real bodycams do), + leans into it, 0 = no lean from turning. Default -3.</font>
<font size="15">Largest camera tilt in degrees. Default 5.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no gun tilt from turning, strafing, weapon inertia or resting tilt. For weapon sway or inertia mods.</font>
<font size="15">Constant tilt the gun rests at in hip fire. Negative tilts the other way, 0 = upright. Default -2.</font>
<font size="15">Constant tilt while aiming down sights. It blends over as you raise the sights. Default -1.</font>
<font size="15">Hip fire only: + points the muzzle up, - down. With Resting Gun Tilt it holds the gun on a diagonal. Default -6.</font>
<font size="15">Extra gun cant per unit of turning speed, on top of the camera lean. Negative leans the other way. Default 3.1.</font>
<font size="15">Largest extra gun cant in degrees. Default 7.</font>
<font size="15">Gun lean = this x camera lean + extra cant. Lower keeps the gun steadier so the camera lean shows more. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">Clamp on total gun lean (not counting resting tilt). Default 16.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the camera leans into a turn. Default 5.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the lean settles back upright once you stop turning. Lower holds the tilt longer. Default 1.5.</font>
<font size="15">Camera tilt when strafing A/D. + leans into the strafe, - away from it, 0 = lean from turning only. Default -2.</font>
<font size="15">Extra gun cant when strafing, scaled by the Intensity Preset. Negative leans the other way. Default 4.5.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the gun rolls into a lean. Lower is smoother and heavier through a left-to-right change of direction. Default 7.</font>
<font size="15">1 = the gun rolls onto its new lean without overshooting. Below 1 it rocks slightly past and comes back, which feels looser. Default 1.</font>
<font size="15">Extra tilt with each step, on top of stride tilt. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no leaning around corners. For other lean or peek mods.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">At a corner with one side open you lean out on your own; tap A or D toward the wall to step back into cover. Leans while aiming; Hip Fire Lean adds some from the hip.</font>

content.help: <font size="15">At a corner with one side open you lean out on your own; tap A or D toward the wall to pull back into cover. Leans while aiming; Hip Fire Lean adds some from the hip. Default 65.</font>
<font size="15">How far the gun turns to point around the corner, in degrees. With Shots Follow set to the barrel this moves where rounds land while peeking. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">How far the view follows the gun around the corner. Default 60.</font>
<font size="15">How far the view lowers as you lean out, like leaning from the hips. 0 = straight sideways. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">View tilt while leading around a corner. Negative tilts the other way. Default 10.</font>
<font size="15">Gun tilt on top of the camera tilt while peeking. Negative tilts the other way. Default 8.</font>
<font size="15">How far ahead to look for a wall. Default 75.</font>
<font size="15">Cover must be within this distance to lead around it. The lean fades in from here. Default 100.</font>
<font size="15">At or inside this distance from cover the lean is at full strength, ramping down to nothing at Cover Detect Distance. Default 30.</font>
<font size="15">How far you turn into the wall before the lean starts. Looking along the wall = no lean. Default 5.</font>
<font size="15">Turned this far into the wall = full lean. Lower is quicker. Default 30.</font>
<font size="15">How much of the aimed corner lean you get from the hip. 0 = corner peek only while aiming. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">How far past facing the wall square you can keep turning and stay leaned out. It lets go over the next 15 degrees. Default 120.</font>
<font size="15">Floor on that ramp, so a far corner still leans a little. 0 = the ramp goes all the way to nothing. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the gun swings out around the corner. Lower is a slower, heavier lean. Default 4.5.</font>
<font size="15">1 = the gun settles into the lean without overshooting. Below 1 it swings slightly past first. Default 0.8.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the view follows around the corner. Keep it below the gun speed so the gun leads. Default 4.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the view and gun come back into cover when the peek ends. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no gun swing when you turn. For weapon inertia or sway mods.</font>
<font size="15">How far the gun swings against the way you turn. With Free Aim on it only tilts and slides, so it does not fight the lead. Default 8.</font>
<font size="15">Largest the inertia swing can get, in degrees, however fast you spin. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">How much the gun tilts with the swing, the same way as Gun Lean Into Turns. Negative flips it, 0 = no tilt. Default 1.25.</font>
<font size="15">How far the gun slides sideways and down with the swing. 0 = no slide. Default 1.25.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly the gun catches back up once you stop turning. Lower is heavier and lazier. Default 5.</font>
<font size="15">Below 1 the gun settles slightly past centre before coming to rest, which reads as organic rather than sprung. 1 = no overshoot. Default 0.85.</font>
<font size="15">Off: the gun does not trail behind sideways movement.</font>
<font size="15">How much the gun trails behind SIDEWAYS MOVEMENT. This one does nothing when you only turn the view - that is Weapon Inertia above. Default 0.075.</font>
<font size="15">Largest gun drag offset. Default 8.</font>
<font size="15">How fast gun drag responds. Default 15.</font>
<font size="15">1 = gun moves with the view bob; above 1 the gun bounces more than the view. Default 1.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">Per-weapon values are peak muzzle climb in DEGREES. Every shot adds to a spring, so automatic fire climbs. The weapon and the view have separate springs - the weapon snaps, the view follows slower. That gap is what reads as force.</font>

content.help: <font size="15">Bodycam's own recoil. Off = vanilla recoil only, at full strength.</font>
<font size="15">How much of the weapon's own recoil is kept alongside Bodycam's. The two stack, so at 1 every shot kicks twice. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">How much of the kick moves your real point of aim, so sustained fire climbs and has to be controlled. 0 = the gun jumps but your rounds do not. Default 0.4.</font>
<font size="15">At 1 the per-weapon Climb value is exactly how far the gun rises on screen. Default 1.</font>
<font size="15">Extra kick on the view, through its own slower spring. Most of the view movement already comes from Aim Impact, so this is only a top-up. Default 0.34.</font>
<font size="15">All recoil x this while aiming down sights. The per-weapon Climb values are the hip figures. Default 0.63.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the weapon rings and settles. Higher = snappier. Default 3.</font>
<font size="15">1 = settles without overshooting; lower corrects past rest first. Default 0.75.</font>

<font size="15">How fast your point of aim comes back down. Keep it WELL below Weapon Recovery Speed - if the aim recovers as fast as the gun, a burst resets between rounds and never climbs. Default 1.25.</font>
<font size="15">1 = the aim comes back down without dipping below where you started. Default 0.75.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the view follows and settles. Measured, Bodycam's view moves WITH the gun rather than behind it, so this sits close to Weapon Recovery Speed. Default 3.5.</font>
<font size="15">How cleanly the view settles. Default 0.75.</font>
<font size="15">How much of the shot you are still recovering from carries into the next one. 0 = every shot kicks from rest, 1 = a full-auto burst climbs hard. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">Random left or right on each shot, as a share of the upward kick. A burst wanders instead of climbing straight. Default 2.</font>
<font size="15">Random twist of the weapon per shot. Visual only. Default 2.5.</font>

content.text: Per Weapon Type (peak muzzle climb, degrees)

content.help: <font size="15">How far a pistol's muzzle climbs on one HIP shot, in degrees. Iron sights get the Aiming Multiplier of this, which lands on the 3.78 degrees measured off Bodycam footage. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">Degrees of climb per shot. Lower than a pistol because it is shouldered. Default 3.7.</font>
<font size="15">Degrees of climb per discharge - once per shot, not once per pellet. Default 10.7.</font>
<font size="15">Degrees of climb per shot for heavy weapons. Default 7.4.</font>

<font size="15">How much each shot differs from the last, as a share either way. 0 = every round kicks identically and a burst climbs in a repeatable staircase; higher makes a string of shots genuinely unruly. Default 0.5.</font>

<font size="15">A short sharp shake of the VIEW on each shot, in degrees, over the top of the smooth recoil. This is a body-mounted camera taking a gunshot rather than gliding through it. Default 1.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the rattle shakes. Higher is a tighter, harsher buzz. Default 22.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly the rattle dies away. 18 is about 150 milliseconds. Default 18.</font>
<font size="15">How hard the shot shoves your viewpoint back, in game units, so the shot lands in your body rather than only in your hands. 0 = no movement, rotation only. Default 0.35.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly your head comes back forward after the shove. Default 9.</font>
<font size="15">After a burst of three or more rounds the weapon drifts and resettles instead of parking cleanly, as if you were readjusting your grip. Degrees. Default 1.2.</font>
<font size="15">Furthest the muzzle can climb, in degrees. Default 18.</font>
<font size="15">Furthest the muzzle can wander sideways, in degrees. Default 5.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">Bob, sway, footstep impact and breathing blend between walk, jog and sprint by your speed, and down to standing still. Bodycam does not change how fast you move, only how the view reacts.</font>

content.help: <font size="15">Off: no walking, running or breathing bob. For other head bob mods.</font>

<font size="15">All the movement motion at once - bounce, side shift, stride swing and tilt, and the footstep kick, at every pace. 0 removes the lot and leaves the camera steady while you move. Default 0.65.</font>

<font size="15">Size of the sharp kick each time a foot lands while jogging. 0 = off. Default 1.5.</font>
<font size="15">How deep your breathing is while jogging. Blends with the pace either side of it, and down to Breathing (Standing) as you stop. Default 0.55.</font>
<font size="15">Breaths per second while jogging. Default 0.85.</font>
<font size="15">How big the up/down footstep bounce is while sprinting. Default 7.0.</font>
<font size="15">Left-right weight shift while sprinting (a slide; subtle on its own). Default 5.0.</font>
<font size="15">View swings left/right with each stride (degrees). View only, never the gun or your aim. Default 0.85.</font>
<font size="15">View tilts left/right with each stride (degrees). View only. Default 0.85.</font>
<font size="15">Full left+right strides per second. Default 1.75.</font>
<font size="15">Size of the sharp kick each time a foot lands while sprinting. 0 = off. Default 3.0.</font>
<font size="15">How deep your breathing is while sprinting. Blends with the pace either side of it, and down to Breathing (Standing) as you stop. Default 0.9.</font>
<font size="15">Breaths per second while sprinting. Default 1.4.</font>
<font size="15">How deep your breathing is when you are not moving. Default 0.35.</font>
<font size="15">Breaths per second when standing still. Default 0.3.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no jump dip or landing kick. For landing or fall camera mods.</font>
<font size="15">How far you load down through the legs as you push off. Off by default - the dip cannot be anticipated, so it fires as you leave the ground. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly you extend back up out of the push-off. Higher is a snappier take-off. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">An extra bouncing kick on landing, on top of the knee bend. Legs do not bounce, so this is off by default. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">Degrees of camera shake when you land. View only, so it never moves your aim. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">How deep you bend to absorb the landing. This is the main landing movement. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">How slowly you straighten back up. Lower is heavier and more laboured. Default 1.8.</font>
<font size="15">Extra drop on the weapon and hands as you land, on top of the view. This is what makes your hands visibly take the hit. Default 4.</font>
<font size="15">The falling speed that counts as a full-force landing. Slower falls scale down from it. Default 700.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the launch and landing kicks ring. Lower is a slower, heavier swell. Default 2.5.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly they die away. Lower lets the landing ride longer. Default 4.</font>
<font size="15">Hops shorter than this get no landing kick, so stairs and kerbs stay quiet. Default 0.15.</font>
<font size="15">Off: no kick when a foot lands.</font>
<font size="15">How fast the footstep kick rings - higher is snappier and harder, lower is a slower, softer swell. Default 4.5.</font>
<font size="15">How quickly the footstep kick dies away - higher is a shorter, tighter thud, lower lets it ride longer. Default 8.</font>

content.text: <font size="15">Fine-tuning. The defaults are the tested values - change with care.</font>
Pace Thresholds - these do NOT change how fast you move

<textformat leftmargin="48"><font size="15">Bodycam never changes your movement speed. These are the speeds the game reports, and they decide which pace's bob applies. To move faster or slower, use a movement mod.</font></textformat>

content.help: <font size="15">Movement speed at which the Walking bob settings are fully applied. Below it they fade towards standing still. Default 130.</font>
<font size="15">Movement speed at which the Jogging bob settings are fully applied; between this and the walking figure the two blend. A typical vanilla jog is around 300-450. Default 340.</font>
<font size="15">Movement speed at which the Sprinting bob settings are fully applied. A typical vanilla sprint is around 500-670. Default 540.</font>
<font size="15">Off: the gun does not pull back at walls. For weapon collision mods.</font>
<font size="15">Gun starts pulling back when a wall is this close. Default 70.</font>
<font size="15">Gun is fully pulled back at this distance. Default 18.</font>
<font size="15">How far the gun pulls toward you. Default 14.</font>
<font size="15">How far the gun lowers. Default 6.</font>
<font size="15">Muzzle tips down this many degrees. Default 22.</font>
<font size="15">Fade the effect out whenever the game is driving the camera itself - dialogue, VATS, furniture, bleedout. Turn off only if the mod goes quiet during normal play.</font>
<font size="15">Fade the effect out while the pause menu, settlement build mode (Workshop) or the Pip-Boy (unless Keep Running In Pip-Boy is on) is open. Default on.</font>
<font size="15">Motion strength while piloting power armor, which already has heavy camera motion of its own. 1 = same as on foot. Default 0.5.</font>
<font size="15">How much footstep bob keeps playing while you are off the ground (jumps, falls, knockback). 0 = none, which is what stops the floating feel. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">Set to -1 if the gun leans the wrong way.</font>
<font size="15">Virtual-key code for aim (used by wall/corner features). 2 = right mouse. Default 2.</font>
<font size="15">Virtual-key code. 65 = A. Default 65.</font>
<font size="15">Virtual-key code. 68 = D. Default 68.</font>
<font size="15">Tap to keep the gun raised out of the low ready, tap again to let it drop. Shooting and aiming still raise it as usual. Default 0.</font>
<font size="15">Turn off all camera motion (lag, lean, bob, sway) to isolate a problem.</font>
<font size="15">Turn off all gun motion (lean, resting tilt, drag, retract) to isolate a problem, e.g. if one-frame glitches appear with frame generation.</font>

<font size="15">Keeps the weapon's motion vectors consistent with the motion this mod adds. Turn off only to check whether it is responsible for ghosting or smearing under DLSS, FSR or frame generation.</font>
<font size="15">Testing aid: keeps the crosshair visible while aiming and puts it exactly where the shot will land, so you can check it against the sight picture. Default off.</font>
<font size="15">Writes Data\F4SE\Plugins\Bodycam.log for troubleshooting.</font>
<font size="15">How fast motion fades in after entering first person or re-enabling. Default 4.</font>
